name: Eastbourne
travel: My home patch, so visits are often same day
intro: Eastbourne is home. I grew up here, spent 13 years working in tech in London, and came back. So whether you're in Meads, Old Town, Hampden Park or down by Sovereign Harbour, I'm usually only a few minutes away. I'll come to you and sort things out at your kitchen table.
local: Lots of my Eastbourne customers are retired and just want someone patient who'll explain things properly, without making them feel silly. I also help local shops, guest houses and holiday lets keep their Wi-Fi and card machines working through the busy summer.
title: Computer help and repairs at home in Eastbourne
h1: Computer help and repairs in Eastbourne
description: Computer and laptop repairs, Wi-Fi, printer, phone and tablet help at home across Eastbourne. Free diagnosis, price agreed first. Call Ryan on 07734 779429.

sections.heading: Computer and laptop repairs in Eastbourne
sections.text: Slow laptops, computers that won't start, viruses and cracked screens can usually be looked at in your own home. I'll find out what's wrong for free, tell you the cost before I start, and quote any parts first. If you'd rather not wait in, you can drop your computer off at 42 Commercial Road, Eastbourne, by appointment.

sections.heading: Wi-Fi, printers, phones and tablets
sections.text: From Wi-Fi that won't reach the back bedroom to a printer that has stopped talking to the laptop, I'll fix it and show you what I did. I also set up new phones, tablets and laptops, move your photos and contacts across, and get video calls working so you can keep in touch with family.

sections.heading: Lost files, scams and staying safe
sections.text: If you've lost photos or files, stop using the device and ring me, because they can often be recovered. If you think you've been scammed, I'll check your computer, help you secure your accounts and explain what to look out for next time.

name: Bexhill-on-Sea
intro: Bexhill has a reputation as one of the calmer corners of the coast, and that's exactly how I like to work: no rush, no jargon. From the town centre near the De La Warr Pavilion out to Cooden and Little Common, I visit homes and businesses for everything from slow computers to new phone set-ups.
local: Plenty of my Bexhill customers have family who live further away, so I often set up video calling, shared photo albums and simple backups that help everyone stay in touch. I'm also happy to work with a relative over the phone so they know exactly what's been done.
title: Computer and laptop repair in Bexhill-on-Sea
h1: Computer and laptop help in Bexhill-on-Sea
description: Laptop and computer repair, plus Wi-Fi, printer, phone and tablet help at home in Bexhill. Free diagnosis, price agreed first. Call Ryan on 07734 779429.

sections.heading: Laptop and computer repair in Bexhill
sections.text: Laptops that have become painfully slow, won't charge or have picked up a virus can usually be looked at in your own home, from Sidley to Cooden. Diagnosis is free, the price is agreed before I start, and if I can't fix it, you don't pay.

sections.heading: Wi-Fi, printers and new devices
sections.text: If the Wi-Fi keeps dropping out in the conservatory or the printer has stopped working again, I'll find out why and fix it properly. I'll also set up new phones, tablets and laptops and show you how to use them, at your own pace.

sections.heading: Scams and staying safe online
sections.text: Had a worrying phone call, or clicked a link you weren't sure about? Ring me. I'll check your computer and accounts, put things right, and show you how to spot the next one.

name: Hastings
intro: Hastings has some of the most characterful homes on the coast, and also some of the hardest to get good Wi-Fi in. Steep streets, thick old walls and split-level houses in the Old Town and up towards Ore all play havoc with signals. I visit across Hastings to sort connections, computers and everything in between.
local: Whether you're retired, working from home or running a small shop in the Old Town, I'll sort out the problem, explain it in plain English and leave you a note of what I did, so you're not stuck next time.
title: Computer repairs and help at home in Hastings
h1: Computer repairs and help at home in Hastings
description: Computer repairs and help with Wi-Fi, printers, phones and tablets at home across Hastings. Free diagnosis, no fix no fee. Call Ryan on 07734 779429.

sections.heading: Computer repairs in Hastings
sections.text: Whether you're in the Old Town, Ore or out at Hollington, I'll come to you, find out what's wrong for free and fix it at home wherever I can. Viruses, slow start-ups, failing hard drives and laptops that won't charge are all things I can help with. You'll know the price before I start, and if I can't fix it, you don't pay.

sections.heading: Reliable Wi-Fi in older homes
sections.text: Thick walls and split levels often need more than a new router. I can check the signal room by room and set up mesh Wi-Fi or a wired access point so every room gets a reliable connection. While I'm there, I'll get printers, smart TVs and tablets connected too.

sections.heading: Help for your parents in Hastings
sections.text: If you're arranging help for a mum or dad in Hastings, I can visit them, sort out what's wrong and send you a short note afterwards, if they're happy for me to. They get someone patient and local, and you get peace of mind.

name: St Leonards-on-Sea
intro: From the grand terraces around Warrior Square to family homes in West St Leonards, I come out to fix the tech that's getting in the way. Converted flats here often have the router in one room and the person who needs Wi-Fi in another, which is a common problem I can solve.
local: I help people working from home, students and retired residents alike. If you'd rather have a quick fix without a visit, remote help is often the fastest way to get sorted, and I can usually connect the same day. Small businesses, cafés and shops along Norman Road and the seafront are welcome too, and I can arrange visits around your opening hours.

name: Battle
intro: Battle is a small market town with a big history, and the villages around it are some of the prettiest in East Sussex. They can also be some of the trickiest for broadband. From the High Street by the Abbey out to Netherfield, Sedlescombe and Catsfield, I'll come to your home and sort out the computer, Wi-Fi or phone that's giving you grief.
local: Out here, the problem is often the connection rather than the computer. Long lines back to the exchange, old copper phone wiring and thick walls in cottages and farmhouses all slow things down. I'll test what's actually reaching your house, tell you honestly whether a new router, mesh Wi-Fi or a different broadband deal will help, and set it up so it just works.

sections.heading: Better Wi-Fi and broadband in rural homes
sections.text: If the signal gives up in the back bedroom, the garden office or the annexe, I can check it room by room and set up mesh Wi-Fi or a wired access point. If full fibre or a different provider has become available in your village, I can help you switch and get everything reconnected afterwards, including the landline if it's moving to a digital phone line.

name: Polegate
intro: Polegate sits just up the road from me, so getting to you is quick and easy. Whether you're near the station or out towards Wannock, I visit for new laptop set-ups, troublesome printers, Wi-Fi black spots and anything else that's stopped working.
local: With so many new homes built around Polegate in recent years, I often help people get their broadband, mesh Wi-Fi, smart heating and video doorbells set up properly from day one, rather than living with whatever the installer left behind.

name: Hailsham
intro: Hailsham and the surrounding villages are a big part of my patch. I visit homes in town and out in the countryside around Hellingly and Herstmonceux, where rural broadband can be a real headache, to get everything connected and working as it should.
local: Farms, small workshops and home businesses around Hailsham often need tech that just works without a big IT contract. I offer straightforward pay-as-you-go help, from email and backups to getting the Wi-Fi out to the office in the garden.

name: Pevensey and Pevensey Bay
intro: From the village around the castle to the bungalows along the bay, I visit Pevensey homes for all kinds of tech trouble. Seaside properties can be tough on signals, so if your Wi-Fi gives up the moment you step into the conservatory, I can fix that.
local: I help many retired residents and holiday-let owners here. For lets, I set up reliable guest Wi-Fi, smart locks and simple TV systems so guests can get settled without needing to call you.

name: Westham and Stone Cross
intro: Westham and Stone Cross are just a short drive away, and I'm regularly out there sorting slow laptops, setting up new tablets and fixing printers that keep going offline.
local: Lots of families here juggle school laptops, games consoles and work-from-home set-ups on one connection. I help get parental controls, Wi-Fi and backups sorted so the whole household runs smoothly.

name: Willingdon
intro: Willingdon is right on my doorstep, nestled under the Downs on the edge of Eastbourne. I visit homes across the village and Lower Willingdon for everything from virus clean-ups to helping you get to grips with a new iPad.
local: Many of my Willingdon customers simply want a friendly, trustworthy person they can call whenever something goes wrong. That's what I aim to be: the same face each time, with clear prices and no pressure to buy anything.
